metadata.change_reason: Data model and storage design quality standard: Mandatory primary keys and indexes, product invariants mapping, and migration/rollback strategies

spec.name: Data Model & Storage Design Quality Standard

rules.statement: Every physical table must possess an explicit Primary Key and index definitions for high-frequency query fields
Must explicitly map and enforce data conservation and state constraints from the product invariants suite (INV-xxx) at the database layer
Must include migration tooling selection and an executable rollback strategy (rollback_strategy)
